free_tier_limits: No ongoing general free tier. The no-credit-card Essential trial lasts 60 days, includes up to 50 services, and is Sandbox-only by default; Production access requires additional information and business verification.
rate_limits: Default production limit: 300 API requests per minute across all API keys in the environment. Additional product-specific creation quotas apply; exact limits are available in the Persona Dashboard and response headers.
